core: Chemotactic migration of leukocytes and astrocytes
name: CXCL12-CXCR4-driven leukocyte and astrocyte chemotaxis
rationale: All members concern directed cell migration (T cell, mast cell, dendritic cell, astrocyte, lymphocyte homing) and its Cdc42/PLC-PKC/pseudopod machinery, and the CXCL12-CXCR4 axis distinguishes it from the CCR/dendritic-cell chemokine and S1P/B-cell homing neighbours.

qualifier: astrocyte versus neuron and oligodendrocyte lineage choice
name: Glial fate specification and astrocyte-oligodendrocyte lineage choice
rationale: Members specify glial fate, favour astrocyte differentiation and restrain neuron and oligodendrocyte differentiation, unlike neighbours on myelination, neural progenitor proliferation or regional neuron patterning.

name: Sensorimotor behaviour and locomotion with glycinergic inhibitory transmission
rationale: Members cover locomotion, proprioception, reflexes, touch, visual behaviour and their neural control, and the glycinergic/inhibitory synaptic transmission (SLC6A5 hyperekplexia, MECP2-GABA, nerve impulse damping) separates it from the exploration/vocalization behaviour neighbours.

qualifier: Hox clusters, somites and hindbrain segmentation
name: Hox-driven axial patterning of somites, hindbrain and neural plate
rationale: Members are Hox clusters, somitogenesis, rhombomere and neural plate/border patterning and axis specification, and the Hox clusters and somite segmentation distinguish it from the notochord/spinal-cord patterning and limb neighbours.

name: Bicarbonate and phosphate transporter defects in mineralization and acidosis
rationale: Members are bicarbonate (SLC4), phosphate (SLC20A2, ABCC6) and cation-exchanger (SLC24) transport and their diseases of enamel/ectopic mineralization and tubular acidosis, unlike SLC26 anion exchange, SLC34 Na/Pi or carbonic anhydrase neighbours.

name: Cellular cholesterol homeostasis via LXR-regulated efflux and reverse transport
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, storage, uptake, biosynthesis and reverse transport, with LXR control and foam-cell restraint distinguishing it from SREBP-driven and HDL assembly/remodelling neighbours.

name: Amino-acid and energy sensing control of mTORC1 signalling
rationale: Members are leucine/methionine/glucose sensing, LKB1-AMPK, AKT-TSC and lysosomal regulation of TORC1 and its translational output, unlike the FOXO/p53 metabolic and protein methylation neighbours.

qualifier: snRNA cap hypermethylation and nucleocytoplasmic transport
name: Spliceosomal snRNP biogenesis and nucleocytoplasmic snRNA transport
rationale: Members cover snRNA transport, cap hypermethylation, snRNP assembly and spliceosome function, which separates the theme from snRNA transcription/splicing-step and mRNA 3'-end processing or decay neighbours.

name: Desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly anchoring intermediate filaments
rationale: Members are desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, intermediate filament bundling and epithelial junction protein localization, with hemidesmosomes distinguishing it from adherens/cardiac junction and cornification neighbours.

name: Regulated nuclear protein import/export and viral nucleoprotein maturation
rationale: Members regulate protein nuclear import and export and the coronavirus/RSV nucleoprotein processes that exploit it, unlike neighbours on SUMOylation, nuclear pore/Rev export or GTPase regulation.

name: Notch and Hedgehog signalling with proteolytic processing and palmitoylation
rationale: Members are Notch receptor processing and NICD transcription, Hedgehog autoprocessing, palmitoylation and GLI processing, plus related intramembrane proteolysis (ERBB4, p75NTR), distinguishing it from the Wnt destruction-complex and Wnt secretion neighbours.

name: p53-dependent transcriptional control of DNA damage-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of death genes and regulation of p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis after DNA damage, unlike neighbours on p53 expression/co-factors, p21 cell-cycle arrest or BCL-2-family mitochondrial execution.

name: Meiotic control of oocyte maturation
rationale: All three members regulate oocyte maturation and its meiotic progression, distinct from follicle development, germ cell proliferation and meiotic spindle mechanics neighbours.

name: Myeloid cell responses to Leishmania, protozoa and bacterial toxins
rationale: Members are macrophage/dendritic-cell defence and IL-10/IL-12 balancing pathways against Leishmania, protozoa, GBP targets and diphtheria/anthrax toxins, unlike Listeria entry, Mtb manipulation, respiratory burst or fungal Dectin neighbours.

name: TRKA signalling through FRS2/ARMS to CREB transcription
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA adaptor (FRS2, ARMS) activation feeding ERK5 and p38 to CREB-driven transcription, unlike TRKA PLC-gamma/STAT3 or NTRK2/NTRK3 neighbours.

name: Lipoxygenase-derived leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis, catabolism and receptors
rationale: Members are 5/15-lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis, omega-oxidation catabolism and leukotriene/prostanoid GPCRs, distinguishing it from resolvin/P450 and cyclooxygenase-prostaglandin neighbours.

name: Epithelial and cardiomyocyte cell-cell junctions with apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members cover adherens and desmosome junctions, epithelial polarity and cardiomyocyte adhesion, unlike cadherin-assembly neighbours lacking cardiac adhesion and the hemidesmosome theme lacking polarity.

name: HSF1 heat shock response and cytoplasmic stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are HSF1 activation and attenuation, refolding and proteostatic stress plus stress granule and PKR/arsenite responses, which the ER-UPR, chaperonin and mitochondrial import neighbours lack.

name: Potassium channel-mediated cardiac action potential repolarisation
rationale: Members cover cardiac action potential phases 1-4, atrial/ventricular repolarisation and Kv, Kir and TWIK channels, unlike depolarisation/conduction neighbours and the non-cardiac K+ channel neighbour.

name: Somite specification and posterior body axis elongation
rationale: All members concern somite formation and polarity and tail/axis elongation, unlike the segmentation-clock (LFNG), gastrulation and neural plate neighbours.

name: Alternative complement pathway activation and amplification
rationale: All three members concern alternative-pathway complement activation and its positive regulation, unlike classical/lectin activation and negative complement regulation neighbours.

name: NIK-dependent non-canonical NF-kB signalling
rationale: Members are NIK activation and non-canonical NF-kB signalling from TNFSF receptors and Dectin-1, distinguishing it from canonical IKK/TNFR1/TLR and T cell NF-kB neighbours.

name: Carnitine-dependent fatty acid uptake and mitochondrial beta-oxidation control
rationale: Members are carnitine shuttle and transport and regulation of long-chain fatty acid import and beta-oxidation, unlike neighbours on general fatty acid transport, medium-chain metabolism or ketone bodies.

name: Visual phototransduction and the photoreceptor retinoid cycle
rationale: Members are opsin phototransduction, its inherited defects and the rod/cone visual retinoid cycle, unlike photoreceptor development or retinoic acid metabolism neighbours.

name: Membrane transport of succinate and other TCA intermediates
rationale: All members concern sodium-coupled transport of succinate and other di/tricarboxylates, unlike urea cycle, glutamate/aspartate metabolism or organic ion transport neighbours.
